children: RNS Number : 0571W  Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC  24 September 2026
Notification of relevant change to significant shareholder
(NYSE AMERICAN: CMCL; AIM: CMCL; VFEX: CMCL)

September 24, 2026: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc ("Caledonia" or "the Company") announces that it received notification on September 23, 2026 from BlackRock, Inc. that on September 22, 2026 it had crossed a threshold for notification of a relevant change (as defined by the AIM Rules for Companies).
A copy of the notification is below.
